review.why: Plans a seven-day LinkedIn calendar by pillar, format, hook formula, CTA and time, with daily comment targets and an inbound check.
review.summary: Takes a theme, audience and pillar mix, then returns a calendar table, three to five comment targets per posting day and a weekly checklist. Guardrails: three to five pillars, no pillar over 60%, no hook formula repeated in a week, goals spread across comments, reposts, likes and saves. A founders edition swaps in a different pillar set.
strengths: Clear guardrails that catch a lopsided week
Angles come from a story bank, and no figure may appear that the user did not supply
Founders variant with its own pillars
cautions: Leans on companion files and skills (story bank, voice profile, numbered hook formulas) outside this file
Posting-day and frequency rules are unverified heuristics
Examples come from the author's own business
